cim_eredeti: Virtual session to discuss how hospitals put AI governance into practice
szoveg_eredeti: The West Health Accelerator at the AHA’s Health Research & Educational Trust will host a virtual session Oct. 29 at 2:30 p.m. ET on how hospitals are implementing artificial intelligence governance. The session will include discussion on how large and small hospitals are evaluating solutions, setting guardrails and navigating real-world adoption. Presenters will also highlight resources from DiMe and the American Heart Association’s AI Torch program. LEARN MORE
